thought.text: Sekarang keduanya 404. Berarti tadi 400 karena body **kosong** `{}`. Saya konfirmasi: validasi jalan sebelum lookup token.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && for body in '{}' '{"claimToken":"x"}' '{"claimToken":"x","recaptchaToken":"y"}' '{"claimToken":"x","recaptchaToken":"y","trigger":"auto"}'; do printf "%-58s " "$body"; curl -s --noproxy '*' --max-time 25 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$body" "https://dash.allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim" -w " [%{http_code}]" | head -c 120; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && for body in '{}' '{\"claimToken\":\"x\"}' '{\"claimToken\":\"x\",\"recaptchaToken\":\"y\"}' '{\"claimToken\":\"x\",\"recaptchaToken\":\"y\",\"trigger\":\"auto\"}'; do printf \"%-58s \" \"$body\"; curl -s --noproxy '*' --max-time 25 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"$body\" \"https://dash.allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim\" -w \" [%{http_code}]\" | head -c 120; echo; done", "summary": "Determine which fields trigger 404", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 150}
